title: Grant docs: conference timeline divergence + missing SPDX header in prfaq-500node-deployment.md
description: docs/prfaq-500node-deployment.md says 'DEFCON, HOPE, and CCC' (stale per wqaa.9 re-anchor: DEFCON Aug 2026 passed; CCC 2026 dry run + DEFCON 34 Aug 2027 flagship) while docs/grant-technical-description.md says 'CCC, DEFCON, and one European spring event'; ARDC doc wisely stays generic. Make PRFAQ + tech description agree (refresh or venue-generic). Also docs/prfaq-500node-deployment.md lacks the CC-BY-4.0 SPDX header the other grant docs carry.
